title: Chicagoland Skydiving Center
specs: First and only solar-powered skydiving facility in the world
On-site full service restaurant and bar with beer garden
Minimum age 18 years, no parental consent forms
Weight limit 250 lbs; surcharges apply for weights 200-220 lbs ($25), 221-240 lbs ($35), 241-250 lbs ($45)
Group discounts available: 3-5 people $20 off per person, 6-10 people $30 off per person, 11+ people $40 off per person; group organizer jumps free
Private group rentals, group transportation, discounted hotel rooms, reserved seating, catering packages available
Facility accommodates events from 10 to 400 guests with catering and event services

blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving jumps from altitudes of 9,000', 14,000', or 18,000' with oxygen available for the highest jump. The facility includes a full-service restaurant and bar, spectator areas, and event spaces for groups and private parties. Group skydiving packages and discounts are available, and the center emphasizes safety with a perfect student safety record.

quotes.text: This has to be one of the top dropzones on the planet. The customer service is amazing, the facilities are stellar and clean, and the staff is some of the best trained I've ever seen. I felt more safe jumping out of their perfectly good airplanes than I do crossing the street.
